args.title: Strip non-ASCII currency symbols in parseAmount
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Update the `parseAmount` function to strip non-ASCII currency symbols like ₹ from the input string so that it can be converted into a valid number.

label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The `parseAmount` function in `src/util/money.ts` is responsible for this issue as it does not strip non-ASCII currency symbols like ₹, causing the input string to not convert into a valid number.
